summary: Single-line or multiline field with @mention and #hashtag suggestions, insertable via keyboard or pointer.
whenToUse: Comments, discussions and messages that support mentions.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Candidate people, provided by the consumer.

props.name: onMentionSelect
props.description: Notifies when a mention is selected.

props.name: hashtagSuggestions / onHashtagSelect
props.description: Enables local hashtag suggestions and notifies the selection.

accessibility: Labeled field with a suggestion list: combobox for the single-line field, multiline textbox for the textarea.
The list state and the active option are exposed through ARIA.
responsive: The suggestion list uses the field width and has a maximum height with scrolling.
customization: Customize borders, surfaces and focus ring with --dc-color-* tokens and CSS Modules.
commonMistakes: Pass stable, unique handles; the component does not perform remote searches.
limits: Suggestions are provided by the consumer; it does not perform remote searches or create new handles.
